command: set -eo pipefail; mkdir -p /work/out/pilot; (while sleep 300; do { date -u +%FT%TZ; du -sb /work/out/shards 2>/dev/null; df -B1 /work | tail -1; cat /proc/net/dev | grep -E 'eth0|ens' ; uptime; } >> /work/out/pilot/samples.txt; done) & start=$(date +%s); export HF_TOKEN="$(cat "$MEGATOKEN_CW_SECRETS/hf-token")"; megatoken codec --output /work/codec; python -m megatoken.cloud_prepare ingest --run configs/cloud/prepare-full-agentic-coding.json --sandbox 0; echo "ingest_seconds $(( $(date +%s) - start ))" > /work/out/pilot/summary.txt; du -sb /work/out/shards >> /work/out/pilot/summary.txt; for d in /work/out/shards/*/; do du -sb $d; done >> /work/out/pilot/summary.txt; cat /proc/net/dev >> /work/out/pilot/summary.txt
